interpretation_boundary: ACM Digital Library, IEEE Xplore, and Scopus were not searched. Prepared plans, web-surrogate candidate discovery, and DBLP replacement evidence do not establish publisher- or index-native coverage, provider equivalence, or exhaustive recall. All three native searches remain stable-v1 gates. The 51 unique candidates across the DBLP and web-surrogate queues were adjudicated under the August 6 cutoff and deferred to the next edition; none was admitted to v1.
